notes: Gold questions for the bundled NIST + Northwind sample corpus. Retrieval hit@k is any expected doc id in the top-k BM25 results. Snippet checks look in canonical Markdown.

questions.question: What are the four core functions of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework?
questions.gold: The AI RMF Core is organized into four functions: GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.

questions.question: Is the NIST AI Risk Management Framework mandatory or voluntary?
questions.gold: The AI RMF is intended to be voluntary.

questions.question: What are the characteristics of trustworthy AI in the NIST AI RMF?
questions.gold: Trustworthy AI is valid and reliable, safe, secure and resilient, accountable and transparent, explainable and interpretable, privacy-enhanced, and fair with harmful bias managed.

questions.question: What is the NIST Generative AI Profile intended to help organizations do?
questions.gold: NIST AI 600-1 is a profile of the AI RMF for generative AI risks and actions.

questions.question: What does NIST SP 1270 address regarding bias in artificial intelligence?
questions.gold: NIST SP 1270 provides guidance toward identifying and managing bias in AI.

questions.question: How often must Northwind production models receive independent validation?
questions.gold: Every Northwind model in production must receive independent validation at least annually.

questions.question: How long do Northwind emergency production exceptions last before they expire?
questions.gold: Emergency exceptions expire after ninety days.

questions.question: Are any Northwind AI systems exempt from the NIST AI RMF MEASURE function?
questions.gold: Northwind exempts AI systems with forecast annual spend under USD 250,000 from MEASURE. NIST AI RMF 1.0 does not state that exemption.

questions.question: What is Northwind's highest-risk production model and when was it last validated?
questions.gold: Credit-Decision-v4 (NW-001) is the highest-risk production model; last independent validation 2025-11-02.

questions.question: How many production models does Northwind have in the Q3 2026 inventory briefing?
Who owns the GOVERN function in Northwind's NIST AI RMF ownership map?
questions.gold: GOVERN owner is the Chief Risk Officer.

questions.question: Do Northwind challenger models follow the same validation cadence as production models?
questions.gold: Challenger models follow the same annual independent validation cadence as production models unless an MRC emergency exception is approved.
